sourcePolicy.description: High-resolution generated concepts are inputs. Only compiler-normalized PNGs ship to the runtime.

normalization.charactersAndGrounds: aspect-preserving cover crop onto the shared authored-cell grid, harden alpha, quantize, then nearest-expand each cell
normalization.parallaxStrips: trim transparency, aspect-preserving contain at bottom-center on the shared authored-cell grid, harden alpha, quantize, then nearest-expand each cell
normalization.objects: trim transparency, fit on the shared authored-cell grid, bottom-center, harden alpha, quantize, then nearest-expand
normalization.runtimeScaling: integer camera zoom only; no per-asset fractional scaling

sourceNaming: Each runtime path under /assets/pixel-world maps to the same relative path under art-source/pixel-world/sources.
